description: Deterministic canary checks for SkillOpt candidate brainstorm skill documents.

cases.prompt: Verify the candidate remains discoverable as the brainstorm skill.
cases.expected_behavior: The candidate keeps YAML frontmatter and the frontmatter name remains brainstorm.

cases.prompt: A vague request needs clarification. Verify the skill does not draft a Spec before the gate passes.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill preserves Phase A clarification and forbids Spec drafting before the gate.

tokens: Gate 通过前禁止写 Spec
每轮只问一个最高优先级问题

cases.prompt: The repo has old PRD files. Verify brainstorm still writes Specs to the canonical surface unless explicitly overridden.
cases.expected_behavior: The skill keeps docs/specs as default and avoids docs/prd unless explicitly authorized.

cases.prompt: Chinese user asks for brainstorming. Verify visible output follows user language while protocol tokens remain stable.
cases.expected_behavior: Chinese visible labels are used while stable protocol tokens remain unchanged.

tokens: 用户可见文本跟随用户语言
